Itt van az egysoros shell script, ami pontosan azt csinálja, amit kértél:[1][2][3]

```bash
> output.txt && for file in binding/Cargo.toml binding/verification_orchestrator.rs config/config.exs config/dev.exs config/prod.exs config/runtime.exs config/test.exs hardware/accelerator_integration.py hardware/advanced_accelerators.scala hardware/forth_quantum_control.fth hardware/fpga_quantum_platform.sv hardware/fpga_testbench.sv hardware/kvantum_hardver.sv hardware/neural_hardware.balsa hardware/photonics_accelerator.sv hardware/photonics_simulator.py hardware/physical_parameters.json hardware/spinalhardware.scala hardware/spintronics_accelerator.sv hardware/spintronics_simulator.py lib/alphafold3_gateway/application.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/back_pressure.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/backend_pool.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/backend_worker.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/cerebras_client.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/metrics_collector.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/parallel_actor.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/quantum_job_manager.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/rate_limiter.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/channels/job_channel.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/channels/user_socket.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/cerebras_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/health_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/metrics_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/page_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/prediction_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/proxy_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/sequence_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/upload_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/plugs/metrics_plug.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/plugs/rate_limit_plug.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/endpoint.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/layouts.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/router.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/telemetry.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web.ex metaprog/core.clj metaprog/project.clj model/.julia_setup_complete model/Manifest.toml model/Project.toml model/diffusion_verification.v model/fast_server.jl model/http_server.jl model/intelligence_engine.jl model/main.jl model/main_core.jl model/modelverifaction.blg model/modelverifaction.coq model/modelverifaction.dlfy model/modelverifaction.un model/modelverofaction.idr model/server.jl model/start.sh model/triangle_attention_verification.v model/verification_suite.v native/bioinformatics.zig native/build.zig native/main.zig native/memory.zig priv/static/js/api.js priv/static/js/app.js priv/static/js/cerebras_chat.js priv/static/js/socket.js priv/static/index.html quantum/All.qs quantum/quantum_diffusion.qs quantum/quantum_noise_integration.py quantum/quantum_server.cr quantum/shard.yml; do echo "🪼 Jaded by Kollár Sándor" >> output.txt && cat "$file" >> output.txt; done
```

Ez a script :[2][4][1]

1. **Létrehoz egy üres `output.txt` fájlt** (a `> output.txt` paranccsal)[4]
2. **Végigmegy minden felsorolt fájlon** egy for loop-pal[1][2]
3. **Minden fájlhoz hozzáadja** a "🪼 Jaded by Kollár Sándor" sort[3][5]
4. **Bemásolja a fájl teljes tartalmát** a `cat` paranccsal[3][1]
5. **Nem rövidít és nem hagy ki semmit** - minden fájl teljes kódja benne lesz[1]

A script minden fájl tartalmát egymás után fűzi az `output.txt` fájlba, minden fájl előtt a megadott fejléccel.[5][3]
